name: Projection and Conditioning Induce Different Coefficient Maps
definition: Let $C=\{0,1\}^3\setminus\{111\}$, whose coefficient space is the open simplex of rows $(a_1,a_2,a_3)$.
properties: Projection to the first two coordinates is a full square and discards the row. Conditioning the third coordinate to one gives the punctured square and maps $(a_1,a_2,a_3)$ to $(a_1/(a_1+a_2),a_2/(a_1+a_2))$. Conditioning it to zero again gives a full square and a one-point coefficient space.
